## First Trust NASDAQ Clean Edge Smart Grid Infrastructure Index Fund ( [GRID](https://money.usnews.com/funds/etfs/infrastructure/first-trust-nasdaq-cln-edge-stgidifsetf/grid))
Rather than focusing directly on renewable power generation, GRID invests in companies involved in electricity transmission and grid modernization. Key holdings include automation and electrification specialist ABB Ltd. (ABBN.SW) as well as utilities like National Grid PLC ( [NGG](https://money.usnews.com/investing/stocks/ngg-national-grid-plc-adr)).
